description_en: Updates the fields in real-time log entries
name: UpdateDcdnUserRealTimeDeliveryField

parameters.help_en:
The type of the collected logs. Default value: cdn_log_access_l1. Valid values:

cdn_log_access_l1: access logs of L1 Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN) points of presence (POPs)

cdn_log_origin: back-to-origin logs

cdn_log_er: EdgeRoutine logs
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型，取值：

cdn_log_access_l1（默认值）：用户访问日志。
cdn_log_er：边缘程序日志。
cdn_log_waf：WAF拦截日志
parameters.name: business_type

parameters.help_en: The list of fields. Separate multiple fields with commas (,). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/324199.html
parameters.help_zh: 字段列表，多个字段用半角逗号（,）隔开。取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/324199.html
parameters.name: fields
